RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel reflects civil service demographics and is not evidence of bias. The appointee has strong credentials, and her international project experience may have aligned more closely with the ministry’s immediate priorities. Civil service hiring typically relies on structured, competency-based scoring frameworks to ensure objective evaluation.

Raising discrimination based solely on the panel's gender composition is unsubstantiated and will harm your professional standing and internal relationships. A two-week delay for formal feedback is routine bureaucratic timing, not a sign of wrongdoing.

Instead, send a polite follow-up asking for your interview scoring breakdown and constructive feedback to identify where you can strengthen future promotional applications.
